question: If b - (1)/(b) = 3 then calculate the value of b⁶ + (1)/(b⁶) ?
solution:
**Given:**

b − 1/b = 3

**Formula used:**

(b − 1/b)² = b² + 1/b² − 2

(b² + 1/b²)² = b⁴ + 1/b⁴ + 2

(b² + 1/b²)(b⁴ + 1/b⁴) = b⁶ + 1/b⁶ + b² + 1/b²

**Calculation:**

(b − 1/b)² = 3²

⇒ b² + 1/b² − 2 = 9

⇒ b² + 1/b² = 11

Now, (b² + 1/b²)² = 11²

⇒ b⁴ + 1/b⁴ + 2 = 121

⇒ b⁴ + 1/b⁴ = 119

Now

(b² + 1/b²)(b⁴ + 1/b⁴)

⇒ 11 × 119 = 1309

⇒ b⁶ + 1/b⁶ + 11 = 1309

⇒ b⁶ + 1/b⁶ = 1309 − 11

⇒ 1298

**∴ Required value = 1298.**
